title: Matrix Algebra I
description: Matrices: simultaneous equations; determinants; vectors in 2-, 3- and n-tuple space; inner product; linear independence and rank; change of coordinates; rotation of axes in 2- and 3-dimensional Euclidean space; orthogonal matrices; eigenvalues and eigenvectors.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of MATH 211, MATH 110, MATH 133, MATH 233A.

items.text: Completed Pre-Calculus 12 with a minimum grade of A (86%)
